settingHint: Disabled items will not appear when you type /. Changes apply after saving.
settingEmpty: No slash menu items found. Open a document in the editor first.
imageScaleEnableDesc: Apply to all images using system DPI: fixed px when DPI width is below editor content width, calc(100% - 8px) otherwise; refreshes on resize (including manually adjusted images).
imageScaleCenterDesc: Injects global CSS: .p:has(span.img) { margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; } without changing block attributes.
autoDpiCompensatedLabel: System DPI: ${dpi} (${percent}%). Siyuan UI zoom ${appZoomPercent}% excluded (devicePixelRatio ${rawPercent}%).
autoDpiUnavailable: Cannot read system DPI; image scaling is unavailable.
panguSpacingEnable: Auto space between CJK and Latin
panguSpacingEnableDesc: Real-time spacing in the DOM while typing; paste is normalized via textPlain, textHTML, and siyuanHTML before render. Spaces around inline code stay outside the code mark. Skips IME composition, code blocks, and title blocks.
docRefStyleEnableDesc: Underline + document icon for document-block refs; strikethrough + default icon when missing. Per-document cache: cleared on close, rebuilt on open; parent doc refreshes after new sub-doc.
childDocIndexToolbarTip: Append missing direct child doc refs at the end
childDocIndexAllExist: All child doc refs already exist
childDocIndexFailed: Failed to build child doc index
locateInTreeToolbarTip: Expand and select this document in the file tree
locateInTreeDone: Located current document in the file tree
locateInTreeFailed: Failed to locate document in the file tree
gatherRefsToolbarTip: Move docs referenced here but not yet under this doc to become its children
gatherRefsNone: No referenced docs to gather (already children or no doc refs)
deleteUnrefToolbarTip: Permanently delete direct child docs not referenced by this document
deleteUnrefSubtreeHint: (${count} also contain sub-docs and will be removed with them)
deleteUnrefFailed: Failed to delete unreferenced child docs
childDocIndexGlobalDesc: Scan the doc tree and append missing direct child doc block refs ((id 'title')) at each parent doc end. Existing refs are not duplicated.
childDocIndexGlobalConfirm: This will append missing block refs for direct children at each parent doc end. Existing refs will be skipped. Continue?
childDocIndexGlobalDone: Done: ${parents} parent docs, added ${added}, skipped ${skipped}, failed ${failed}
childDocIndexGlobalDoneCancelled: Cancelled: added ${added}, skipped ${skipped}, failed ${failed} before stop
childDocIndexNotebookDesc: Select a notebook to append missing child doc refs only within that notebook.
childDocIndexNotebookConfirm: Append missing child doc refs only in "${name}". Existing refs will be skipped. Continue?
